note: RFC 8654 Section 5 forbids accepting Extended Messages when the receiver has not advertised capability 6; the peer's advertisement is not permission to receive. Re-read every tagged unit: TestValidateLengthWithMax checks exact 4097 rejection without extension and 65535 acceptance with extension, identifying failures as NOTIFICATION 1/2; TestRFC8654ReceiveLimitFollowsLocalOPEN drives actual OPENs for all four advertisement combinations and both readers at 4096, 4097 and 65535, requiring exact intact consumer payload and Established/no response for accepted input, or exact 1/2 with erroneous Length and no consumer dispatch for rejection. Its positive tag covers forbidden receive admission being refused and its negative tag covers the permitted local-only case; header tags use the complementary polarity convention but exercise distinct inputs and exact outcomes. The completion-only sender receive is correctly not an assertion about rejection: read-ahead can finish the write, while the independently asserted wire notification and zero dispatch prove rejection. checkExtendedRemoteOnlyRejectFRR and checkExtendedNeitherRejectFRR delegate to checkExtendedMessages/checkExtendedReceiveRejection, which verify original local OPEN advertisement separately from relay-delivered copies, observe an actual FRR over-4096 UPDATE, demand exact rejection with offending Length, and wait for the original FRR session to close. Producers capability.Negotiate and Session.negotiateWith set receive permission from local advertisement; both readers pass it to Header.ValidateLengthWithMax before payload admission. No semantic assertion was lost to the join comment. Source audit only; no interop or native execution claimed.
